chapters.title: Pattern A: High-Density Pooled Multi-Tenant Architecture
chapters.script: Welcome to Blog two, building Pattern A high-density pooled multi-tenancy inside a single shared Google Cloud project with strict isolation.

chapters.title: The 10 Cross-Tenant Breach Vectors in Pooled Agent Runtimes
chapters.script: Shared pools face ten breach vectors, including warm container memory residue, cache key collisions, noisy neighbors, and unscoped database queries.

chapters.title: Pattern A Shared Runtime, Registry & Data Plane Blueprint
chapters.script: Pattern A layers default-deny identity, dynamic registry tool pruning, and database row-level security so competing tenants safely share compute.

chapters.title: Stateless Pool Copy-on-Write Pre-Fork & One-Shot gVisor Isolation
chapters.script: In stateless mode, Cloud Run Gen two pairs copy-on-write pre-forking with single-request concurrency so worker memory never leaks across tenants.

chapters.title: Stateful Session Pod WarmPool & Strict 403 Tenant Latch
chapters.script: For long-running stateful sessions, each GKE warm pod latches cryptographically to one tenant and gets recycled automatically after session teardown.

chapters.title: Hop 5 AlloyDB Transactional RLS & BigQuery OpenTelemetry FinOps
chapters.script: At Hop five, database engines enforce row-level security natively inside the storage kernel while OpenTelemetry streams exact tenant cost attribution.

chapters.title: Live BigQuery Studio: Pooled Bleed vs. Pattern A Tenant RLS
chapters.script: These live BigQuery Studio captures contrast seven mixed baseline rows against our active row access policy filtering strictly for FinVault.

chapters.title: Pattern A Multi-Cloud Scorecard: Google Cloud vs. AWS & Azure
chapters.script: Across multi-cloud benchmarks, Google Cloud Pattern A delivers the highest tenant density and strongest SaaS margins with strict isolation.
